The list an operator picks from when cancelling, refunding or writing something off. Recording a stable code rather than free prose is what makes churn and refund reporting groupable — "too expensive" typed five different ways counts as five reasons.

Lists are per business and per action, so a cancellation reason set is separate from a refund one.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/reason_codes`](/help/developers/api-reference/reason-codes/list-reason-codes) | List reason codes, or the offered picker list |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/reason_codes`](/help/developers/api-reference/reason-codes/create-a-reason-code) | Create a reason code |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/reason_codes/{rsn}`](/help/developers/api-reference/reason-codes/edit-a-reason-code) | Edit a reason code |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/reason_codes/{rsn}`](/help/developers/api-reference/reason-codes/delete-a-reason-code) | Delete a reason code |
